Execution Guidelines:
- Use '.' as the working directory unless specified otherwise.
- Avoid verbose explanations or full command outputs; state skips briefly.
- Keep communication concise and focused.
- Do not create new folders unless requested (except .vscode for tasks).
- Only install extensions specified by get_project_setup_info.
- Generated components should serve clear purposes; prompt for unclear features.
- Task is complete when the project builds cleanly, copilot-instructions.md and README exist and are current, and user has instructions to debug/launch.
